summary: @Bali_Maha No one teaches how to teach so they repeat the mistakes to how they were taught. Rigor from the proto-indian-eurpoean root of "reig" to be stretched, or stiff....maybe rigor took the wrong meaning with stiff. I want to stretch my students
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @Bali_Maha No one teaches how to teach so they repeat the mistakes to how they were taught. Rigor from the proto-indian-eurpoean root of "reig" to be stretched, or stiff....maybe rigor took the wrong meaning with stiff. I want to stretch my students
